name: Purple Sky
source:
Kaito is a troubled young man who has a pretty dark vision of the world. Everything seems to end up being repeated, again and again. Until one day, death appears to him, and she offers her place. From that moment, everything changes.

[From [url=http://albertfox.itch.io/purple-sky]itch.io[/url]]

Created for TyranoBuilder Summer Game Jam 2015.
translation:
海斗是个饱受困扰的年轻人，对世界抱有十分黑暗的看法。一切似乎都会一遍又一遍地重复，直到某天，死亡出现在他面前，并提出让他取代自己的位置。从那一刻起，一切都改变了。

[来源：[url=http://albertfox.itch.io/purple-sky]Itch.io[/url]]

为TyranoBuilder 2015年夏季游戏创作大赛制作。
